verdict.rationale: Segment ships Consent Management and a Privacy Portal that let end users set preferences to opt out of data collection/tracking, and supports GDPR/CCPA/HIPAA compliance, which partially maps to a telemetry opt-out capability. However, this addresses opting out end-users of data tracked *through* Segment by its customers, not an AI-native developer opting out of Segment's own product usage telemetry — no evidence addresses that specific angle. Missing for 10: explicit opt-out mechanism for Segment's own usage/telemetry collection about the product itself, and any AI-agent-specific consent flow or documentation.
